steps.en: Install on OpenClaw; configure server addresses and a bot token
steps.zh: 在 OpenClaw 安装并配置服务地址与令牌

steps.en: Logs in and listens for messages through the OpenIM SDK
steps.zh: 通过 OpenIM SDK 登录并监听消息

steps.en: Mention the bot with a text request in your Teamily group
steps.zh: 在 Teamily 群里以文字提及机器人并提问

steps.en: Passes the request and buffered group context to OpenClaw
steps.zh: 把请求和群聊缓存上下文交给 OpenClaw

steps.en: Sends OpenClaw's reply back through the same account
steps.zh: 通过同一账号把 OpenClaw 回复发回群里

value.en: Your existing assistant answers inside Teamily without a custom transport bridge
value.zh: 现有助手在 Teamily 内回答，无需自写消息桥接
